After every change, with nothing to press. An SD card folder is updated within seconds and copies only what changed. A cloud app\'s backup file holds the whole vault, so it is rewritten a few minutes after you stop making changes, or at once when you lock. A vault you never open is never copied.

A cloud app sees one file: its size and when it changed. What\'s inside is sealed, so it can\'t count or measure your files. An SD card folder shows how many files there are, each one\'s size rounded up to a fixed step, and when each changed — items over 16 MB show as a group, and the pattern could identify them as this app\'s backup. Neither sees a name, a date, an album, or anything inside a file.
Each vault needs its own backup. Every backup also holds the same encrypted list of vaults, so someone who can see two of them can tell they belong together.
